messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

First, the Manager checks the open leads. Afterwards, he selects the top five ones. He then tells his Sales Assistant to call the contact person of the leads. The Sales Assistant calls each customer. If someone is interested, he sends a note to the Manager. The Manager then processes the lead. Otherwise, he calls the next customer.

    <task id="Task_CheckLeads" name="Check open leads">

      <outgoing>Flow_2</outgoing>
    </task>

    <task id="Task_SelectTop5" name="Select top five leads">

    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_ReceiveNote" targetRef="Task_ProcessLead"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_ProcessLead" targetRef="EndEvent_1"/>

      <messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_2"/>

      <incoming>FlowSA_Loop</incoming>
      <outgoing>FlowSA_2</outgoing>

      <incoming>FlowSA_2</incoming>
      <outgoing>FlowSA_Yes</outgoing>
      <outgoing>FlowSA_No</outgoing>
    </exclusiveGateway>

    <sendTask id="Task_SendNote" name="Send note to Manager">
      <incoming>FlowSA_Yes</incoming>
      <outgoing>FlowSA_3</outgoing>
    </sendTask>

    <endEvent id="EndEvent_SA" name="End">
      <incoming>FlowSA_3</incoming>
    </endEvent>

    <sequenceFlow id="FlowSA_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_SA" targetRef="Task_CallCustomer"/>

    <sequenceFlow id="FlowSA_No" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Interested" targetRef="Task_CallCustomer"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="FlowSA_Loop" sourceRef="Gateway_Interested" targetRef="Task_CallCustomer"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="FlowSA_3" sourceRef="Task_SendNote" targetRef="EndEvent_SA"/>
